tagline: Newport’s riverfront, where two rivers meet.
intro: Along Newport’s riverfront, Riverboat Row reaches General James Taylor Park, overlooking the meeting of the Ohio and Licking rivers with Cincinnati beyond. The park occupies the former Newport Barracks grounds.

Nearby, East Row keeps houses from Newport’s years of trade and industry. Italianate buildings along the district’s western edge give way to later Queen Anne and Colonial Revival homes, on land subdivided from the Taylor family estate.

moments.title: East Row Historic District
moments.text: Houses favored by Newport’s merchants and business owners preserve Italianate and Queen Anne work on land subdivided from the Taylor family estate.

moments.title: General James Taylor Park
moments.text: On the former barracks grounds, the park overlooks the Ohio and Licking confluence and Cincinnati’s skyline.
